feedback_text: The app is clear and I could track my order without any issues.
My invoice is incorrect and I have been waiting two weeks for a correction.
The delivery arrived three days late and I did not receive a clear update.
Login usually works well, but the verification code sometimes arrives a bit late.
The support agent solved my question quickly and was very friendly.
The dashboard has useful numbers, but I miss an export to Excel.
The return process is unclear and I could not find the return label.
I was helped calmly and the explanation was easy to follow.
The search function often shows irrelevant results.
We would like to see more clearly when our contract will be renewed.
The payment went through quickly and the confirmation arrived immediately.
I receive too many notifications and cannot choose exactly which ones I want.
The product feels sturdy and matches the description.
Adding new users fails without a clear error message.
The courier was friendly, but the delivery window was too broad.
The text on the website is small and some buttons are hard to find.
Changing my address was easy and it was saved immediately.
The API documentation is usable, but examples for error handling are missing.
I returned my order three weeks ago and still have not received my refund.
Since the update, the app opens much faster.
The website works fine, but some categories are in unexpected places.
Technical support thought along with us and understood our setup.
My package arrived damaged and the box was open.
I would like a simple confirmation after an automatic debit.
My shopping cart was emptied after reopening the app.
The new invoice overview is clear and saves us time.
The student discount is nice, but the conditions could be clearer.
I received a standard reply that did not solve my issue.
The new filters make it easier to quickly find the right product.
The CSV export contains duplicate rows and sometimes misses column names.
Resetting my password eventually worked, but the steps were a bit cumbersome.
The new help page with larger buttons is an improvement.
The product photos are nice, but the dimensions are not clearly listed.
Two-factor authentication gives us more confidence when managing accounts.
Push notifications sometimes arrive twice.
Changing my delivery appointment was surprisingly easy.
The price increase was not communicated clearly in advance.
The app crashes every time I open my order history.
The employee took the time and stayed patient when I did not understand something.
I would like interim status updates during return processing.
